headline: Set planBTV New North End public hearings for November 23 and December 7, 2026; postponed Burlington Forward resolution to December 7.
summary: Members set two public hearings on the planBTV New North End plan, for November 23 and December 7, 2026. They postponed a revised Burlington Forward resolution to December 7, 2026. They also referred two charter change proposals to a committee and approved an assistant city attorney appointment.
decisions: Approved the October 5, 2026 City Council meeting minutes, unanimously, as part of the consent agenda.
Approved the reclassification of the Human Resources Manager position from Grade 20 to Grade 21, unanimously, as part of the consent agenda.
Approved a $2,000 sponsorship grant to the Congolese Community of Vermont, unanimously, as part of the consent agenda.
Approved a $5,000 sponsorship grant to Vermont Professionals of Color for The Latin American Connection Festival, unanimously, as part of the consent agenda.
Approved the appointment of an acting ward clerk for Ward Three and acting inspectors of election for Wards Three, Four, and Eight, unanimously, as part of the consent agenda.
Waived the first reading and referred Ordinance ZA-27-03 to the City Council Ordinance Committee, unanimously, as part of the consent agenda.
Adopted the resolution honoring Andrew Champagne, unanimously.
Approved the one-day special event indoor entertainment permit for Muddy Waters, 184 Main Street, October 31, 2026, 10 pm - 2 am, unanimously.
Approved the appointment of Chloe Vickers, Esq. as Assistant City Attorney, unanimously.
Set planBTV New North End for public hearings on November 23, 2026 and December 7, 2026, unanimously, as amended.
Referred the proposed charter change on non-citizen voter protections to the Charter Change Committee, unanimously.
Referred the proposed charter change on modernizing city government to the Charter Change Committee, unanimously.
Approved the second reading and adoption of the ordinance on trespass on city property appeal hearing timelines, as amended by the Ordinance Committee, unanimously.
Postponed the revised Burlington Forward resolution to the December 7, 2026 City Council meeting, 10-2.
Approved a request that the Mayor create an Ad-Hoc Special Committee, with a progress report due December 7, 2026, 9-3.
